sector_model: Software and outsourced financial services (nonfinancial): P/E, FCF after capitalized software, leverage and refinancing, buybacks vs FCF, SBC.
thesis: SS&C (Nasdaq: SSNC), financial-services software and outsourced fund administration. Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-11-09) read. Q3 revenue 1,690.0M vs 1,568.0M (+7.8%), 9M 5,032.8M (+9.0%); tech-enabled services +10.6% 9M, license flat. Q3 NI attributable 198.9M vs 210.0M (-5.3%) on a higher tax rate (58.6M on 256.7M pretax vs 43.5M on 253.9M); 9M NI 659.8M vs 603.8M. TTM NI 852.9M (796.9-603.8+659.8). TTM OCF 1,859.8M (1,744.8-1,101.3+1,216.3) less PP&E capex 47.5M and capitalized software 256.6M = FCF 1,555.7M (capitalized software deducted). Close 74.15 (2026-11-20) x 234,815,941 shares (cover, 2026-11-04) = 17.41B = 20.4x TTM NI, FCF yield 8.9% (about 7.5% after 9M SBC of 185.8M annualised, own estimate). Debt 7,449.5M carrying (260.0 current + 7,189.5) vs cash 525.4M, net debt about 6.9B. Post-quarter refinancing: 1,200M 2.75% convertibles due 2031 with capped calls, term loan upsizes, revolver extended to Nov 2031, 2,000M 5.5% notes due 2027 to be redeemed in Q4 2026. 9M buybacks 760.5M plus dividends 199.8M = 960.3M vs 9M FCF 989.1M (about 97%). Client funds (3,846.5M) are matched by obligations and excluded from cash and debt.
counterthesis: Equity-method line shows 40.8M adjustment against income in 9M (unconsolidated affiliates, cause unread); effective tax rate rose to 24.5% (9M) from 19.9%, so earnings growth lags revenue. Leverage is high (about 6.9B net debt, interest bearing) and capital return nearly equals FCF; stock fell from 79.54 to 74.15 over 11-16 to 11-20 with cause not found. Share count benefited from buybacks while SBC runs near 250M a year. Intangibles amortization (544.7M D&A in 9M) makes GAAP NI understate cash, so P/E flatters nothing but EBITDA and adjusted views were not reconciled. Convertible adds potential dilution above an unread conversion price; AI disruption of software-enabled services unassessed.
invalidation: Downgrade if tech-enabled services growth falls below about 5%, tax rate stays above 24%, net debt/FCF rises as buybacks continue, or the equity-method losses recur. Upgrade needs peers (BR, FIS, FI, SEIC), own multiple history, the 10-22 release and guidance read, convertible terms and verified quote origins.
